title: Marie Curie
text:
Marie Curie was a famous scientist. She was born in Warsaw, Poland, in 1867. When she was young, she loved science and books. Later, she moved to Paris to study.

In Paris, she worked with her husband, Pierre. Together they found two new elements. Marie won two Nobel Prizes, and she is still famous today.

questions.text: How many Nobel Prizes did Marie win?
What kind of child do you think Marie was?
options: She was curious and loved learning

questions.text: How do you think Marie felt about her work with Pierre?
options: She did not care about it

came into the world at the start of life
basic substances that cannot be broken into simpler substances

paragraph_translations: Maria Skłodowska-Curie była znaną naukowczynią. Urodziła się w Warszawie w Polsce w 1867 roku. Kiedy była młoda, kochała naukę i książki. Później przeprowadziła się do Paryża, aby studiować.
W Paryżu pracowała z mężem, Pierre'em. Razem odkryli dwa nowe pierwiastki. Marie zdobyła dwie Nagrody Nobla i do dziś jest sławna.
